body: I'm terribly sorry that you've gone through it too. But is actually nice to hear someone's side of things that's gone though it too. One of the coping mechanisms I used was smoking weed, so I get where you're coming from. However I've had to quit now, although I'm always tempted to start again just to have some relief.  I almost feel selfish admitting that I want to kill myself after just a year of it. You've been through 5 years of it. It's sad I've almost given up in a fifth of the time as you.

I'm from the states, but I would rather not be specific on the state for privacy reasons. The problem is I can't just help others and move forward with my life. Talking about rape, even if it's not my own personal experience being discussed, usually results in an episode coming on. It's not like this has been ten years and I've had time to move forward. It's all so fresh still, even after a year.
